title: Replace blocky sedan with a detailed textured concept car
summary: Bundle the authored Khronos Car Concept GLB with interior, original materials and textures, door/hood/hatch pivots and attribution.

changes.detail: Detailed authored car asset: 11,778,688 bytes, 213,347 triangles, embedded textures and CC BY 4.0 attribution/provenance.
Primitive procedural sedan from the default experience; retained original source for historical development tests.
Bind authored panel pivots and actual mesh groups, preserve textured PBR materials, adapt camera and bundle asset for local loading.
Distinguish concept-car model from BMW comparison lessons; unsupported mechanical systems remain lessons without invented geometry.

validation.name: Pending final integration
validation.detail: Asset metadata and license reviewed; build, render, camera, pivot, mobile, interaction and history checks pending. No production deployment or physical device validation.
